# Changed example: the search that must reach the last item

Export `searchTitles(titles, query)` from your module.

- `titles` is an array of strings, `query` a string.
- Return the titles whose text contains `query`, comparing after trimming the query and ignoring case.
- A whitespace-only (or empty) query returns ALL titles.
- Preserve title text and order; do not mutate `titles`.
- Return `[]` when nothing matches (including for an empty array).

This is the U02 delayed transfer: a search fails only at the last item. Before you code, name two different causes that would produce exactly that failure and the experiment separating them — then make sure your loop cannot be one of them.

tests.name: matches are trimmed and case-insensitive
tests.code: assert.deepEqual(mod.searchTitles(['Fix the loop', 'Write tests', 'Ship it'], '  LOOP '), ['Fix the loop']);

tests.name: a match at the LAST item is found
a whitespace-only query returns every title
no match and empty input both return []
does not mutate the input

items.wrongBecause: the loop runs i < titles.length - 1, so the final title is never examined: the search fails only at the last item — exactly the off-by-one boundary the U02 delayed transfer asks you to diagnose before editing
